sourceAnchor.text: Exact spoken clause covered by this shot.

motionPatternContract.relationshipStatement: Several visible inputs are assembled into one coherent result.
motionPatternContract.selectionRationale: M03 is selected because the meaning is many inputs becoming one result, not one source splitting into many outputs.
motionPatternContract.primaryLawEn: Keep one destination stable while the inputs enter in a readable order and become one completed result.
motionPatternContract.triggerEn: A visible submission or locking action starts the assembly.
motionPatternContract.attentionPathEn: Move attention from the first input through the remaining inputs and finish on the single result.
motionPatternContract.resultProofEn: The final frame contains one stable assembled result and no unprocessed input remains.

durationPlan.selectionRationale: Three strong visible events form a short many-to-one sequence that fits the seven-second narration clause directly.

knowledgePoint: The exact spoken idea that benefits from a concrete visual treatment.
viewerInference: What the viewer should understand after the shot.
routeReason: The specific comprehension, emotional, or memory benefit alongside retained foreground.
startStateEn: One observable starting state with the approved subjects and object count.
causalActionEn: The central meaningful action, interaction, or reveal; describe causality only when the spoken idea is causal.
resultStateEn: The final readable state or relationship; physical transformation is not required.

referenceContract.borrow: The empty grid, ordered module assembly, and stable completed state.
referenceContract.doNotCopy: Demo wording, exact layout, colors, logos, or source content identity.

currentShotReference.purpose: A current-shot-specific 2048x1152 visual solution for the actual subject, composition, material hierarchy, and opening state.

firstFrame.state: The clean original starting state, without text or UI.
firstFrame.allowedMotionEn: Only the named causal objects may move away from this exact opening state.

referenceImage.purpose: For Ref2VA only: the current-shot-specific content, layout, subject, and style reference; it is not an endpoint.
referenceImage.doNotCopy: Nothing from the current shot; preserve its intended subject and spatial hierarchy while omitting baked-in text or UI.

referenceImage2.purpose: For Ref2VA only: one complementary palette, material, or composition mechanism that does not duplicate Picture 1.
referenceImage2.doNotCopy: Reference wording, brand, logo, character identity, exact layout, or unrelated content.

referenceVideo.purpose: For Ref2VA only: the selected motion law, attention path, camera behavior, depth behavior, and settling rhythm.
referenceVideo.doNotCopy: Reference subject identity, brand, wording, storyline, soundtrack, or unrelated content.

motionBeats.mechanismEn: Establish the source subject and its available destinations.
Carry the selected motion law through the visible causal transformation.
Decelerate into the stable result and hold the attention endpoint.

visualStyleEn: A coherent original explanatory visual with tactile material, controlled hierarchy, and no baked-in text.
initialCompositionEn: A clean 16:9 composition with one central mechanism and controlled negative space.
cropSafetyEn: Keep every essential subject, causal action, and final-state cue inside the central crop-safe region; only expendable context may sit near the left and right edges.
subjectContinuityEn: Preserve approved subject identity, object count, palette, material, and spatial relationships throughout the shot.

phases.actionEn: remain still in the exact opening composition
phases.outcomeEn: the starting relationship becomes immediately readable

phases.actionEn: perform the single motion law in a clear ordered progression
phases.outcomeEn: the viewer can follow exactly how the relationship changes

phases.actionEn: settles and stops at its final destination
phases.outcomeEn: the completed result remains stable and visually proves the point

cameraEn: Use one restrained slow push-in during the causal action, then settle and remain locked.
endStateEn: Reach the described result and hold it without drift for at least 0.6 seconds.
overallSoundscape: Quiet synchronized tactile sounds only; no speech and no music.

foregroundCoexistence.duplicateAvoidance: H3 provides a concrete scene or experience; Remotion retains useful labels, diagrams, structured knowledge, titles, captions, and material. Related meaning is valid when visual functions differ.
